content:
olivia-n: hey folks, day one hiccup. trying to add my redwood account to the iPad Mail app and Okta blocks the sign-in with 'device not compliant'. i need email for onboarding links and 1Password invite. any quick unblock?

devex_jai: welcome! :wave: our conditional access requires device compliance for IMAP/Exchange protocol on unmanaged devices. two fast ways: 1) install the Gmail app (OAuth/SAML => works without device compliance) or 2) enroll the iPad in MDM (we use Kandji) so the Mail app becomes compliant. which iPad is it (personal or company)?

olivia-n: personal iPad for now. i tried Gmail app but it won't let me add the account because Okta forces a device-check before redirect. the error says "compliance required by policy".

it_support_bot: Ticket created: #IT-4902 - "iPad Mail blocked by conditional access for olivia-n". Assigned to it_mobile_admin. Status: open.

it_mobile_admin: hmm. sometimes the Gmail app uses the browser flow which still triggers our device-check. quick test: try adding via the Gmail app's Add account -> Google and see if the in-app browser shows the Okta MFA prompt. if it breaks, we can grant a 6-hour exception for web/OAuth so you can finish onboarding and accept 1Password invite.

olivia-n: tried that, it opens Okta in the browser and still errors out. i can't complete the SSO to reach 1Password.

peopleops_maya: we can either: A) ship a company iPad that will be enrolled and compliant, or B) give a short-lived web exception so you can finish initial provisioning from a laptop or phone. which do you prefer?

security_anais: security prefers enrolling personal devices into MDM for access to sensitive corp apps, but we allow short exceptions for new hires to finish onboarding. if you take the exception, we'll log it and require enrollment within 7 days.

devex_jai: short-term workaround I use: use your phone's Chrome, open incognito, go to okta.redwood.com, sign in, complete MFA, then open the 1Password invite link from that session (or copy the invite URL to your phone). once 1Password is accepted you can use the 1Password app on iPad (it supports sign-in via email+SMS code). could you try from your phone?

olivia-n: ok trying on my phone now. incognito flow lets me finish Okta MFA and I can see the 1Password invite page but it still asks to verify device on first sign-in.

it_mobile_admin: fine, granting a 6-hour Okta web exception for olivia-n so OAuth flows from mobile browsers succeed. you should be able to accept 1Password and then use the 1Password iPad app to finish setup.

it_support_bot: Update: #IT-4902 changed status to in_progress (it_mobile_admin). Temporary web exception granted (6h).

olivia-n: worked! accepted 1Password invite on phone and installed 1Password on iPad. can access team docs and onboarding checklist now. thanks team.

peopleops_maya: following up on shipping: do you want a company iPad enrolled in Kandji, or will you enroll your personal device? we recommend company device for long term.

olivia-n: i'll use my personal iPad for a few days and enroll it in Kandji this week. if anything blocks, i'll DM.

security_anais: reminder: once you enroll personal device, you'll need to enable device passcode and disk encryption (FileVault for macOS, device passcode for iOS) per policy. we'll check compliance automatically.

it_support_bot: #IT-4902 resolved. If access recurs, reopen the ticket or tag @it_mobile_admin.

devex_jai: welcome aboard again! if you want help migrating email to native Mail after Kandji enrollment, ping me. typical command for SSH keys when you're ready: `ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "olivia@redwood.com"` and paste pub key to profile.

olivia-n: will do, thanks everyone :heart:
